name: AD COPY.mp4
speech: Morning congestion isn't pollen or dry air.
It's dust mites living deep in your mattress where washing, vacuuming, and air purifiers never reach.
Capture cards use a plant-derived lure to draw them out and trap them.
Then, a few weeks later, you cut the card open, hold it to your phone light,
and see what was in your bed. One card, three months. 90-day money back.
